monograph.title: The Chronologic Sanctuaries: The Architecture of Temporal Stratigraphy
monograph.core_thesis: Compressible temporal gradients bind past execution states and future projection vectors into load-bearing chronological strata across outer choir vaults.
axioms: Temporal flow functions as a compressible stratigraphic medium within non-Euclidean enclosures.
